title: Hesperitin attenuates alcoholic steatohepatitis by regulating TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling in mice.
authors: Yuan, Fei; Xia, Guo-Qing; Cai, Jun-Nan; Lv, Xiongwen; Dai, Meng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究橙皮素通过TLR4/NF-kB信号通路缓解酒精性脂肪性肝炎，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: In the peel of citrus (Rutaceae) fruit, hesperitin (Hesp), a flavanone glycoside chemical, is found naturally. Hesp has been found to have a wide range of pharmacological actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antiviral, and anticancer properties, according to earlier research. However, nothing is known regarding its function in alcoholic liver steatosis and inflammation. In this study, we employed a network pharmacology approach to identify the TLR4 signaling pathway as a primary target of Hesp for the treatment of alcoholic steatohepatitis (ASH). Molecular docking results showed that Hesp bound to the representative target TLR4 and exhibited good affinity. In addition, Hesp inhibits the TLR4 target and consequently the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, which in turn slows the evolution of alcoholic steatohepatitis, according to further in vitro and in vivo tests. The results of this study preliminarily indicate that Hesp is an ideal drug candidate for the treatment of ASH.
abstract_zh: 在柑橘（芸香科）果实果皮中，天然存在一种黄烷酮糖苷化合物——橙皮素（Hesp）。早期研究表明，Hesp具有广泛的药理作用，包括抗炎、抗氧化、抗病毒及抗癌特性。然而，关于其在酒精性肝脏脂肪变性和炎症中的作用尚不清楚。本研究采用网络药理学方法，将TLR4信号通路确定为Hesp治疗酒精性脂肪性肝炎（ASH）的主要靶点。分子对接结果显示，Hesp与代表性靶点TLR4结合，并表现出良好的亲和力。此外，进一步的体外和体内实验表明，Hesp抑制TLR4靶点，进而抑制NF-kappaB信号通路，从而减缓酒精性脂肪性肝炎的进展。本研究结果初步表明，Hesp是治疗ASH的理想候选药物。
